title: made a browser dino roguelike
author: SijiLoroTelu123
selftext:
hey, I’ve been building this game called Dino-Conquest with claude and it’s finally playable start to finish. I’ve looked at it so long I can’t tell if it’s fun anymore so I need some fresh eyes

you hatch a dino and fight through 5 zones with a boss at the end of each one. it’s turn based but you tap at the right time to hit harder and block, so skill actually matters. it’s supposed to be hard  
  
inspired by pokemon, pixel lineage (roblox), slay the spire

totally free, no ads, nothing to buy. works on phone and pc

mostly want to know if it’s too hard, if anything feels annoying, and any bugs you find (especially on phones)

link: [https://dino-conquest-five.vercel.app/](https://dino-conquest-five.vercel.app/)

thanks!
